Sheet 'Tab 1g' uses row labels 'Impaired facilities to loans and advances' and 'Non-performing to loans and advances' for the aggregate ADI ratio.

No visible level shift was found around the 2018 AASB 9 expected-credit-loss transition: maximum quarter-to-quarter change was 0.10 percentage points and the 2018 mean differed from 2017 by 0.02 percentage points.

APRA's explanatory notes say asset-quality data were updated from the March 2022 reference period, replacing the concept of impaired with non-performing; this output therefore marks the measurement basis for each quarter.
